# SYNTHETIC SAMPLE — invented numbers, not results

**Every value in this folder was generated by a formula.** The site does not exist, the
horizon is two triangle waves, the Sun and the Earth move on invented circles, the body
radii and the sphere radius are invented round numbers, and the UTC labels ignore the
offset between TDB and UTC. Nothing here may be quoted, plotted as a finding or shown to
anyone as output of the tool.

The sample exists so that readers (web charts, Three.js view, Unreal scene, event finder)
can be written and tested against the exact file layout of the contract before real data
is available. Each package says `"synthetic": true`, carries a `synthetic_notice`, and
every method card has validation status `synthetic`.

| Path | Content |
|---|---|
| `SYNTHETIC_scenario.json` | The scenario the sample was produced from |
| `packages/index.json` | List of the packages below |
| `packages/direction_table/<id>/` | Direction-table package: 769 hourly records, Sun and Earth |
| `packages/site/synthetic-sample-site/<id>/` | Site package: horizon for 6 observer heights and 1440 azimuths with its obstacles (four per height: an invented far ridge, an invented near rock field and two stretches between them), a 30-day hourly series, events, windows, metrics, the blocker of every sample and the time lost to each obstacle, the lunar-day calendar, and the landing windows and slip tolerance for the invented example requirement of the scenario, the band for an invented horizon error and the survey of an invented landing ellipse (9 points) |

Regenerate and check:

```
python -m lsncore sample
python -m lsncore validate docs/contract/sample/packages/site/synthetic-sample-site/*
```

The files are not edited by hand. A test (`core/tests/test_contract.py`) validates them
and compares them with a fresh run.
